about: What the sealed check of the relational-model line refuses (seeddrift/train/rel/sealed.py; every stage that reads data calls it). (1) The sealed test part of the medium corpus: the 257 genomes with split 'test' in the training-data index named here (the corpus split three ways: held-out part by salt 'split', test part from the rest by salt 'test', every 4), found under <CI root>/runs or <CI root>/imports/runs and checked by its sha256; <CI root>/host/sealed_registry.json must exist (the check fails without it, so tables are built on machine i-1), its test split must be the same genomes, and its aliases are refused too. Stages that read table sets accept only sets whose manifest records a passed check (seeddrift/train/rel/handoff.py). (2) The sealed island chromosomes and the benchmark-v2 sealing candidates, by accession (with or without version, any case, inside composite names). (3) By full lineage (CI environment only; ci/stages/rel/common.py check_lineage): bench/hard/EXCLUDE.tsv as gate G2 reads it, plus the exclusion lists named here. Owned by the coordinator (C0); changing it changes what every round may use.
